g.text: HTTP Session Model and Deep-Thinking Confirmed Configuration
read Agent binding and current modelId
no mutation and no domain event
[target model does not support deep thinking]
context headers, If-Match, and boolean thinking

The public models field is a string array of modelId values.
Names and display metadata come from the caller model catalog.
The current model can be absent when it was disabled later.
thinking controls whether deep thinking is enabled.
The change applies only to executions accepted afterward.
POST emits thinking events only for executions accepted with true.
GET retains persisted original thinking after later toggles.
Each read checks current access; ordinary pages have no expiry.
Durable session.model_changed and session.thinking_changed entries are visible in GET Events.
They are audit facts and are not restored as model conversation messages.
